uncertainties.item: Year-model term tables converted to equipment_age_years
uncertainties.reason: The catalog has equipment_age_years but no model-year field. I converted model-year bands using the 2025 guideline year, e.g. 2020-New as age <= 5 and 2016-2019 as age 6-9.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm whether the underwriting engine should calculate age from model year dynamically rather than storing fixed 2025 conversions.

uncertainties.item: Dump truck single-axle versus tandem-plus terms
uncertainties.reason: The table gives different treatment for 2015-2018 dump trucks: Single Axle is NA and Tandem+ is 36 months, but there is no catalog field for axle configuration.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add an axle_configuration or dump_truck_type field if this distinction must be automated.

uncertainties.reason: The construction table varies term by heavy, medium, and light classes, but the catalog only has equipment_category=construction and no construction-weight class field. I captured only the overall 60-month maximum.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add construction_equipment_class with heavy/medium/light options to encode the full table.

uncertainties.reason: The guideline says Restaurant Equipment is eligible only for approved franchises, but the catalog has no franchise/approved-franchise field.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add is_approved_franchise or handle as manual review for restaurant equipment.

uncertainties.item: Medical equipment must be medical doctor
uncertainties.reason: The catalog field is is_licensed_medical_professional, which is broader than medical doctor. I mapped the requirement to that field as the closest available option.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add is_medical_doctor if the narrower distinction is required.

uncertainties.reason: The document excludes cash-out transactions, but transaction_type has no cash_out option. Refinance and sale_leaseback exclusions were encoded separately.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add cash_out as a transaction_type option or a separate is_cash_out field.

uncertainties.item: Straw purchase / investor deals not allowed
uncertainties.reason: No catalog field represents straw purchase or investor-purpose transactions.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add is_straw_purchase and/or is_investor_deal fields for automated enforcement.

uncertainties.reason: The California rule applies to applicants and dealers, but the catalog only has business_state for the applicant/business and no dealer_state field.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add dealer_state if dealer geography should be checked automatically.

uncertainties.reason: The document requires title upfront, DOT inspection, third-party inspection, original contracts for private-party/consignment transactions, and treats consignment as private party. The catalog can only encode titled equipment and transaction_type private_party; it has no consignment, DOT, inspection, or original-contract fields.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add fields for consignment, title_received_before_closing, dot_inspection_required/completed, third_party_inspection_completed, and originals_received if needed.

uncertainties.item: Non-CDL owners buying CDL-required equipment must have 10 units
uncertainties.reason: There is no explicit field for CDL-required equipment or owner CDL status by owner. I approximated using has_cdl=false and truck equipment categories likely to require CDL.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add equipment_requires_cdl and owner_has_cdl fields for precise automation.

uncertainties.item: Personal guaranty by owners with 10% or more ownership
uncertainties.reason: The guideline requires all owners with at least 10% ownership to guaranty, but the catalog has no fields for ownership percentage or guaranty status.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add required_guarantors_completed or owner_ownership_pct/owner_guaranty fields.

uncertainties.reason: All financed equipment must be insured for at least the amount financed with Citizens Bank as loss payee and max $2,500 deductible, but there are no insurance fields in the catalog.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add insurance_coverage_amount, loss_payee_confirmed, and insurance_deductible fields.

uncertainties.reason: GPS Required is a program condition, but there is no catalog field for GPS installed/required. It was placed in program details only.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add gps_installed or gps_required_acknowledged if this should be automated.

uncertainties.item: Class A CDL for startup trucking
uncertainties.reason: The guideline specifies Class A CDL for 5 years, but the catalog only has cdl_years and has_cdl without CDL class.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add cdl_class field if Class A must be distinguished.

uncertainties.reason: The document references TransUnion Credit Score; the catalog has fico_score described as the lowest score across guarantors. I used fico_score >= 700.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm whether TransUnion score should be mapped to the generic fico_score field.

uncertainties.item: Cannabis related equipment/businesses are not desired
uncertainties.reason: The document says 'not desired' rather than an absolute exclusion. I modeled it as a soft industry rule and could not separately encode cannabis-related equipment because no equipment option exists.
uncertainties.suggestion: Confirm whether cannabis should be a hard decline and add cannabis_equipment indicator if needed.

uncertainties.reason: The trailer table says terms may adjust due to high/low hours on a reefer unit, but the catalog has no equipment-hours field.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add equipment_hours for reefer and heavy equipment term adjustments.

uncertainties.reason: The document states engine overhauls do not help with term guidelines, but there is no catalog field for engine overhaul and no rule adjustment to encode.
uncertainties.suggestion: If relevant, add engine_overhauled field but keep term logic based on original age/mileage.

uncertainties.item: Cross-corp transactions considered depending on credit performance
uncertainties.reason: No catalog field represents cross-corporate transactions or related credit performance.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add is_cross_corp_transaction if routing/manual review is required.

uncertainties.reason: The FAQ requires documentation and approval for brokers/vendors not already approved, but the catalog has no broker/vendor approval fields.
uncertainties.suggestion: Add vendor_approved and broker_approved fields if broker/vendor eligibility should be automated.
